phrases.home.heroTitle: Self-Care For The Black Sheep & Bold Hearts
phrases.home.heroText: For anybody who's ever been told they're a little too much: taking up space and smelling amazing was always the plan.
phrases.home.badge1Text: Nothing mass-produced. If it's in stock, Savanna made it recently, by hand, on purpose.
phrases.home.badge2Text: Not a rainbow logo slapped on in June. This shop is queer at the root, year-round.
phrases.home.badge3Text: Calendula, arnica, magnesium, shea: stuff you can actually pronounce and trust.
phrases.home.badge4Text: Grown at farmers markets and Pride tables across the Upstate, one conversation at a time.
phrases.home.featuredText: The stuff y'all keep coming back for, from the flagship tee to the salve that actually gets your skin (and your sleep) to behave.

phrases.auto.skinSafeTriblendFabric.f6410e: 100% skin-safe triblend fabric. Non-irritating and breathable.
phrases.auto.ozTinThatSoftens.2ecfa8: A 2 oz tin that softens coarse facial hair, calms the itch underneath, and smells like a stiff drink and cedarwood instead of a drugstore aisle. Light hold, zero grease, genuinely good gift material.
phrases.auto.miniSpellJarWax.1e5414: A mini spell jar, wax-sealed and clipped to a sturdy keyring. Pick your blend below. Five inches of everyday witchy armor for your keys, bag, or backpack.
phrases.auto.richScoopableCreamDeodorant.3eeb02: A rich, scoopable cream deodorant handmade for long-lasting freshness and odor control without aluminum. This buttery formula melts into the skin, spreads easily, and dries down with a smooth, non-greasy feel. Scented with a fresh, earthy blend of lavender, cedarwood, orange, and tea tree. 2 oz amber glass jar.
phrases.auto.allTheGoodsAll.2debe6: All the goods, all the moods. Soft apparel for showing up exactly as yourself, salves & balms for cracked heels and rougher days, body & skin stuff that smells like a good decision, soaks that turn a bathtub into a religious experience, and a potions & spellwork corner for the witchy little accessories you didn't know you needed. The apparel is our own original artwork; every salve, soak, and scrub is mixed, poured, and stirred by hand in small batches right here in Landrum, SC.
phrases.auto.aromatherapyAndSpaceClearing.8fbf12: Aromatherapy and space-clearing mist. For room and threshold use; avoid spraying directly into eyes.
phrases.auto.aromatherapyMistForAmbient.e8ae84: Aromatherapy mist for ambient room and linen clearing. Spray on a hidden fabric corner first to verify colorfastness.
phrases.auto.attachToYourKeyring.7848d0: Attach to your keyring, backpack, purse, or altar space as a handheld protective talisman. Handle with positive intention.
phrases.auto.bakingSodaCanIrritate.5c6295: Baking soda can irritate freshly shaved or sensitive underarms. Try a small amount for a day or two first. Contains essential oils and almond oil.
phrases.auto.bestsellerUnscentedEssentialOil.ca1: Bestseller, Unscented, Essential oil free, Sensitive safe
phrases.auto.buffGentlyOntoWet.7e79ad: Buff gently onto wet skin in circular motions during shower or bath. Rinse thoroughly with warm water to reveal silky soft, exfoliated skin.
phrases.auto.cantWaitToHear.4c3b9c: Can't Wait To Hear From You
phrases.auto.cedarwoodSweetOrangeAnd.7025e6: Cedarwood, sweet orange, and patchouli under a black-gold shimmer that photographs as good as it feels. That's the Seduction blend, one of three scents this comes in. Lightweight, fast-absorbing, and built for festivals, Pride, and anywhere else you plan on shining harder than everyone around you.
phrases.auto.comesWithReusableOrganic.bce0ec: Comes with a reusable organic cotton muslin bag. Each bag is good for 2–3 soaks. Compost when spent.
phrases.auto.containsLavenderAndBlack.7501e5: Contains lavender and black pepper essential oils. For sensitive skin, test a dilute pinch in warm water on inner wrist.
phrases.auto.containsPotentPeppermintAnd.f5d002: Contains potent peppermint and eucalyptus essential oils. Test on forearm before first full soak; avoid eye contact.
phrases.auto.customerReviewsSocialProof.2b465c: Customer Reviews & Social Proof | Y'allternative Living
phrases.auto.deepSheaRestWhipped.dfd89d: Deep Shea Rest, whipped thick with raw African shea and a lavender-forward blend underneath. Massage it into damp skin after your shower and let it work on cracked heels and winter-dry patches while you sleep. Built as a night ritual, not just a lotion.
phrases.auto.digitalCertificateDeliveredInstantl: Digital certificate delivered instantly via email. Save or print your voucher code for safe keeping.
phrases.auto.digitalCreditAllergenFree.3f9459: Digital credit — 100% allergen-free, valid for all products and never expires.
phrases.auto.driedLavenderChamomileRose.6d0046: Dried lavender, chamomile, rose petals, and oat straw in a reusable muslin bag. Drop it in a warm bath, let it steep five minutes, soak until the day stops mattering. Gentler on your tub than loose herbs, and the bag's good for two or three rounds before you compost the whole thing.
phrases.auto.enterYourUniqueDigital.a6a4e4: Enter your unique digital gift card code at checkout on yallternativeliving.com to redeem toward any purchase.
phrases.auto.essentialOilFreeBut.d2a0fa: Essential-oil free, but not a mild formula: the sudsing base brings sodium lauryl sulfate, denatured alcohol and methylisothiazolinone with it. If your skin is reactive, or you already know MI is one of yours, this is not the tin for you.
phrases.auto.exactSaltHerbBlend.111b07: Exact salt/herb blend varies by the option you choose above.
phrases.auto.exfoliatingScrubWithPumice.4500d1: Exfoliating scrub with pumice and pink salt in a sudsing surfactant base that contains methylisothiazolinone, a known contact allergen. Test a small amount on hands before first heavy use, skip it entirely if you know you react to MI, and avoid open cuts.
phrases.auto.farmersMarketsPrideEvents.377246: Farmers markets, Pride events, and everywhere else folks need a little glitter and grit. We keep our folding table moving through the season. Follow along on Instagram and TikTok @yallternativeliving for the schedule so you can shop in person.
phrases.auto.followYallternativelivingOnInstagra: Follow @yallternativeliving on Instagram and TikTok for the real-time pop-up schedule. That's where we post exactly where the table's landing next.
Follow @yallternativeliving on socials to see where we're heading next.
phrases.auto.followAlongForThe.28d8d0: Follow Along For The Live Schedule
phrases.auto.formulatedWithoutEssentialOils.d278: Formulated without essential oils or added fragrances for ultra-sensitive skin. As with any botanical balm, test a small dab on inner wrist before first full use.
phrases.auto.getGiftVoucherDelivered.08afcb: Get a $5 gift voucher delivered to your inbox on your birthday.
phrases.auto.gotCustomOrderBrewing.818ddf: Got a custom order brewing, a wholesale question, or just want to tell us your dog's name? We're all ears. Pick whichever door's easiest and come on in.
phrases.auto.gotQuestionsAboutShipping.7aaeec: Got questions about shipping, returns, ingredients, custom orders, or where to find us? We've got answers. Take a look below, and if you still need help, reach out on our contact page.
phrases.auto.growingUpInThese.8c886b: Growing up in these foothills, you get handed sweet tea in one hand and a church potluck plate in the other. If you're anything like me, you spend years thinking you have to pick a side: country or alternative, Southern or strange. Turns out, this dirt raised a whole quiet army of us: alt kids working the peach stand, emo kids who still say "y'all," queer folks who never left because this is home too. Backroads, porch lights, and sweet tea still run through everything I make here—eyebrow-raising parts included. Y'allternative Living is for every one of us who got tired of choosing.
phrases.auto.handmadeSmallBatchAnd.cc1e5f: Handmade, small-batch, and mixed for you - not for a demographic. Grab a jar and make yourself at home.
phrases.auto.imTheHandsThe.734fa9: I'm the hands, the nose, and most days the mouth behind Y'allternative Living. Every salve, soak, and scrub gets mixed, poured, and labeled by hand right in Landrum, SC. No factories, no focus groups. Just me, my kitchen, and an unreasonable number of jars.

phrases.auto.keepInCoolDark.1292d2: Keep in a cool, dark place away from heat vents or direct sun. Shelf life is 6–12 months.
phrases.auto.keepJarSealedTightly.3cf8e6: Keep jar sealed tightly and avoid introducing standing water into jar. Shelf life is 6–12 months.
phrases.auto.keepLidClosedBetween.608c85: Keep lid closed between uses to prevent excess water from entering the tin. Shelf life is 6–12 months.
phrases.auto.keepUnusedTeaBags.1b6630: Keep unused tea bags in a dry, airtight jar or pouch. Compost spent botanicals after 2–3 uses.
phrases.auto.pumicePinkSaltAnd.ea164f: Pumice, pink salt, and sugar for the grease and grime; coconut and olive oil so your hands don't pay for it. It lathers, so there is a sudsing surfactant base in the mix too, listed in full on the label. A 2 oz tin built for hands that work for a living.
phrases.auto.pureDriedBotanicalsAnd.21fa76: Pure dried botanicals and mineral salts. Test steeped herbal water on wrist if prone to botanical pollen sensitivities.
phrases.auto.rainbowLayersOfSweet.3a82e9: Rainbow layers of sweet exfoliant that slough off the rough, leave skin soft, and look like a Pride parade in a jar. Glitter-and-grit self-care that means exactly what it says: everybody's welcome.
phrases.auto.relaxationWithSideOf.23a8e9: Relaxation with a side of rebellion: lavender, black pepper, and rosemary dissolved into a 10 oz bag of Epsom salt and baking soda. Run the bath, toss in a scoop, take up all the space you want.
phrases.auto.rubLittleOntoYour.6e2cf3: Rub a little onto your feet or shoulders before bed and let lavender, chamomile, and cedarwood take it from there. Magnesium and arnica in a 2 oz tin, built for overthinkers and night owls who need the day to actually end.
phrases.auto.sameRainbowStagSame.956b41: Same rainbow stag, same crescent moon, cut for the hottest days of the year. Soft triblend racerback built to be worn hard and washed easy. Original artwork, not something pulled off a mass-print catalog.
phrases.auto.scoopGenerousAmountAnd.841097: Scoop a generous amount and massage directly into towel-damp skin immediately after bathing or showering to lock in deep hydration.
phrases.auto.scoopNickelSizedAmount.585973: Scoop a nickel-sized amount onto damp hands. Work thoroughly into palms, knuckles, and cuticles in circular motions, then rinse clean with warm water.
phrases.auto.scoopOutSmallAmount.2acbb9: Scoop out a small amount with clean, dry fingers and massage into clean, dry underarms. Start with less than you think you need. You can always add more.
phrases.auto.scrapeThumbnailSizedAmount.2ee775: Scrape a thumbnail-sized amount, warm between palms until melted, and work upward through beard into the underlying skin. Comb through to style.
